title: Design, molecular docking and suppression on NF-kappaB activity of sinomenine hybrid derivatives.
authors: Tang, Jian; Jiang, Chunbao; Zhu, Yuling; Wen, Chongwei; Xu, Xiuquan; Xia, Haiping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究青藤碱杂合衍生物对NF-kappaB通路的抑制，涉及分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未聚焦TF-DNA结合机制，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Sinomenine possesses potent suppression on the nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) pathway. The phenylpropanoid moiety was introduced into sinomenine for building dual-structure sinomenine hybrid derivatives. The software AutoDock Vina was used to dock the sinomenine hybrid derivatives with 3 key proteins (1VKX, 4KIK and 6YMN) of NF-kappaB activation, and the virtually screened derivatives were tested via molecular dynamics simulation. Three series of derivatives were synthesized by Heck cross-coupling reaction, and evaluated for their suppressive effects on NF-kappaB in HEK 293 cells transfected with plasmid pNF-kappaB-luc. Some 1-acrylate sinomenine derivatives showed more active suppressive effects than the parent sinomenine. Derivatives 1-3 of sinomenine series were more active on NF-kappaB than other three series. Derivative 3 with 1-phenethyl acrylate was the most active one.
abstract_zh: 青藤碱对核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）通路具有强效抑制作用。为构建双结构青藤碱杂合衍生物，将苯丙素部分引入青藤碱中。使用AutoDock Vina软件将青藤碱杂合衍生物与NF-kappaB激活的3个关键蛋白（1VKX、4KIK和6YMN）进行对接，并通过分子动力学模拟测试虚拟筛选出的衍生物。通过Heck交叉偶联反应合成了三个系列的衍生物，并评估了它们在转染pNF-kappaB-luc质粒的HEK 293细胞中对NF-kappaB的抑制作用。一些1-丙烯酸酯青藤碱衍生物显示出比母体青藤碱更活跃的抑制效果。青藤碱系列中的衍生物1-3对NF-kappaB的活性高于其他三个系列。具有1-苯乙基丙烯酸酯的衍生物3是最活跃的。
